description: This file contains utility functions for database interaction with a PostgreSQL database using the psycopg library. It includes configuration for connection setup, context management for connections, and basic CRUD operations like fetch_one, fetch_all, execute, and execute_returning_one.

methods.name: str _build_dsn_from_env()
methods.description: Builds a Data Source Name (DSN) string for PostgreSQL connection from environment variables.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a query and returns a single row as a dictionary, or None if no results.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_all(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a query and returns all matching rows as a list of dictionaries.

methods.name: None execute(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes a non-returning SQL statement such as INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] execute_returning_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None)
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement that returns a single row, typically INSERT ... RETURNING, raising an error if no row is returned.

ctags.name: execute
ctags.pattern: /^def execute(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> None:$/

ctags.name: execute_returning_one
ctags.pattern: /^def execute_returning_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_all
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_all(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_one
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_one(query: str, params: Optional[Sequence[Any]] = None) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
